load_rule: Load every issues_*.json shard listed in files below, including numbered continuation shards.
Apply superseded_mandatory_issue_ids and superseded_deferred_issue_ids before computing active work.
Read closed.json before implementation so disproven findings are not reintroduced.
For parallel execution, read WORKER_PLAN.json and WORKER_GUIDE.md before claiming or editing any issue.
For the first released cohort, use G0_LAUNCH_PROMPTS.md; do not launch later phases before their gate.
Workers may act only on their assigned primary issue IDs and write domains unless Vozhd explicitly reassigns ownership.
Original shards remain immutable evidence; worker plan/guide schedule their execution but do not alter issue meaning.

files.WORKER_PLAN.json: required machine-readable dependency/ownership plan for parallel execution
files.WORKER_GUIDE.md: required human execution/launch guide for parallel execution
files.G0_LAUNCH_PROMPTS.md: copy-paste launch prompts for currently released G0 workers
